# tiny — hand-checkable MovieLens-format dataset

Generated by `generate.py` (committed; deterministic). 245 ratings, 30 movies, 20 users, 11 tags.
See the docstring in `generate.py` for the deliberate edge cases.

User 3's last four ratings share one timestamp. Their order (and so which of them land in test)
is decided by the split's seeded tie-break `mix_seed(seed, user, item)`, which is not computable on
paper: tests involving user 3 must compute the expected order with `recs::mix_seed` rather than
hard-code it.
